description: A pair of eyeglasses lies on the bed next to a small folded white case, with a dark pillow propped at the back. The right hand reaches in from the right to grasp and lift the glasses as a right-hand object, while the left hand slides in from the left to steady and open the white case; then the right hand lowers and places the glasses into the opened case as the left hand holds the case in place, and both hands fold the case closed around the glasses as a two-hand object.
